overview: India Digital Hub — a super app unifying all major Indian government services (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport, Ration Card, utilities, finance) into one beautifully designed, accessible platform with biometric login, glassmorphism UI, and preloaded demo data.
features: Glassmorphism dashboard with Electric Indigo gradient
5 service categories: Identity, Food Security, Utilities, Finance, Travel
Verified/Pending/Not Linked status cards per service
Preloaded demo data on first login
Dark mode default with light mode toggle
Profile page with biometric credential management
